Archive_Room_Start.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Start.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{blip:1}Well, I was investigating the incident{nl}and several things caught my attention...

Archive_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Start.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}If you don't mind, could you tell me about it in more detail?

Archive_Room_Start.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Start.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Let me think... What should I ask about...){color:white}{topicUnlock:Archive_Blood}{topicUnlock:Archive_Script}{topicUnlock:Archive_Curse}{topicUnlock:Archive_Vase}{setState:archive_intro_done,true}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}See that cardboard box over there?{nl}It contains fake blood.

Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.text: But apparently, they weren't planning to use{nl}fake blood in this play.

Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}And how does that relate to the victim?

Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["ScratchingHead"]}{blip:1}W-well, you see...{nl}Sorry, I got ahead of myself!

Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}To put it simply, the victim was{nl}apparently afraid of the color red.

Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.text: {blip:1}During rehearsal, she had a nosebleed once,{nl}and apparently it caused quite a panic.

Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.text: From what I heard, she just sat down on the spot{nl}and couldn't move at all.

Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}...That sounds less like a dislike{nl}and more like a phobia.

Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Determined"]}{blip:1}The victim was afraid of the color red.{nl}So they weren't planning to use fake blood in the play!

Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Archive_Blood_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(So, why is this like a quiz show...){p:300}{flash}{playSound:cling}{color:white}{addEvidence:FakeBlood}{showEvidenceIcon:right,FakeBlood}{p:1500}{hideEvidenceIcon}{setState:talked_archive_blood,true}{jump:Talk_Archive_Check}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Archive_Blood_Repeat.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Blood_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}The victim was afraid of red.{nl}So they didn't use fake blood in the play. Simple as that.{sectionEnd}

Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}I read the script for this play pretty quickly{nl}and...

Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}There were about 10 actors in total,{nl}including supporting roles,

Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Determined"]}but only the two leading actors{nl}are supposed to go inside the barbed wire cage!

Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.text: A big-name actress gets hit by a glowing vase,{nl}and after all that, they end up in a cat fight with smiles on their faces!

Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["ScratchingHead"]}Apparently Don came up with the idea,{nl}but genius's way of thinking is hard to understand.

Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}They say there's a fine line between genius and madness,{nl}and Don is probably...

Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{blip:1}Yeah, right.{nl}I won't fall for that again.

Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Archive_Script_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Let me think... What should I ask about...){color:white}{setState:talked_archive_script,true}{jump:Talk_Archive_Check}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Archive_Script_Repeat.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Script_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Honestly, who would try to pull off a script like that?{nl}Genius or madman...{sectionEnd}

Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{blip:1}He recently became a board member at Joypolis.

Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Thinking"]}Ever since then, murder cases have been{nl}happening consecutively at Joypolis.

Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.text: {blip:1}There was the Tonosaman Fall murder case{nl}where Maya was initially suspected.

Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.text: Then there was the Locked Room Murder case{nl}involving Ninja Nanja that was key to solving it.

Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Determined"]}Don must be drawing in something sinister!

Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.text: {blip:1}Probably evil spirits or something like that.{nl}This is at the point where we need an exorcism!

Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Archive_Curse_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(...Well, spirits aside,{nl}it's true that there are a lot of incidents at Joypolis){color:white}{setState:talked_archive_curse,true}{jump:Talk_Archive_Check}{sectionEnd}

Talk_Archive_Curse_Repeat.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Curse_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Thinking"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}If it's not evil spirits that are causing this,{nl}then there must be another reason.{sectionEnd}

Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Sad"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}I just can't stop thinking about that vase...

Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{blip:1}Haven't you seen it?{nl}The vase with letters written on it.

Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.text: There are 5 letters of the alphabet{nl}written on that vase!

Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["ScratchingHead2"]}{blip:1}I'm a huge Sonic fan, you know.

Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.text: The color's different, but doesn't my back hair{nl}kind of look like Sonic's?

Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{blip:1}That vase is even in the play's program!{nl}I've seen it there!

Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.text: {blip:1}Among all the props used in the play,{nl}only the vase was painted with luminescent paint.

Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(So Mareka claims that she hit the victim{nl}with this glowing vase prop)

Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.name: Phoenix
Talk_Archive_Vase_Intro.text: {color:lightblue}(Could that glowing fragment we found{nl}in the ring be...)

Talk_Archive_Vase_Repeat.name: Gumshoe
Talk_Archive_Vase_Repeat.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}That fragment from the vase is proof that{nl}corroborates what Mareka said.{sectionEnd}

Archive_Room_TalkLoop.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_TalkLoop.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Let me think... What should I ask about...){color:white}{sectionEnd}

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}By the way, you know that.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: Just before the incident happened, all the actors{nl}and staff had a meeting by the ring.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: And apparently, the power went out during that meeting.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(A meeting with everyone just before the incident...{nl}and a power outage in the middle of it...)

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Thinking"]}{blip:1}A power outage in this day and age?{nl}Don must have cut corners on the budget.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}Don is famous on TV, right?{nl}195 centimeters tall, 150 kilos, a former fighter.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: But he's also intellectual and smart...{nl}With big muscles comes a big brain.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: And what's impressive is his charismatic gaze!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: Even actresses who absolutely refuse to wear swimsuits{nl}in public would be mesmerized by his wild eyes,

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Determined"]}and they'd change into swimsuits{nl}right in front of him!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(What kind of ability is that...)

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{blip:1}He's not just the king of entertainment.{nl}He's the Don of entertainment!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Thinking"]}But for all his greatness,{nl}he cut corners on such a small budget!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}Kind of funny, isn't it? Hehehehe!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}Whoa! Detective Gumshoe!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Complete.text: ...Don is right behind you.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}{blip:1}Ha ha, very funny.{nl}I won't fall for that trick again.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Don
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["FixGlasses"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Glare!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Sad"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Don
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}I retired from fighting to take over the business.{nl}It doesn't mean my strength has faded.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Don
Archive_Room_Complete.text: I could always let you experience firsthand{nl}that my power hasn't changed since my active days.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Thinking"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}N-no, please!{nl}I was just worried about you{nl}and Joypolis...

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Don
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Worried?

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Thinking"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}With all these murder cases happening,{nl}Joypolis's reputation would suffer.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {sprite:Gumshoe["Normal"]}Pretty soon it'll be more like{nl}a Criminal Amusement Park!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}W-wait, Detective Gumshoe...

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Don
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["FixGlasses"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Glare!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Sad"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: That was a thoughtless remark!

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Don
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Don["Normal"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Once I take control of Joypolis,{nl}I'll wipe away all these bad rumors in no time.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {blip:0,true}{color:white}Take control of Joypolis?

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Don
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {blip:1}A troublesome board member is gone.{nl}It's now assured that I'll take control of the business.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(...A troublesome board member?{nl}Is he talking about the victim?)

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Don
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {blip:1}Well then, I'll be taking my leave.

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {hideTextbox}{sprite:Gumshoe["Sad"]}{hideCharacter}{fadeInCharacter}{showTextbox}{blip:1}Wow, I nearly had a heart attack...

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Gumshoe
Archive_Room_Complete.text: Between cold sweat and hot sweat pouring out,{nl}I think I've lost some weight...

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {blip:0,false}{color:lightblue}(Well, I think I've heard enough here.)

Archive_Room_Complete.name: Phoenix
Archive_Room_Complete.text: {color:lightblue}(Once I have all the evidence,{nl}I'll head to court and make everything clear!){color:white}{setState:archive_room_done,true}{setAction:talk,false}{playSound:jingle}{sectionEnd}
